relations.name: Petroboscan
relations.quote: Chevron has a 39.2 percent interest in Petroboscan, which operates the Boscan Field in western Venezuela

relations.name: Petroindependiente
relations.quote: a 25.2 percent interest in Petroindependiente, which operates the LL-652 Field in Lake Maracaibo

relations.name: Petropiar
relations.quote: Chevron has a 30 percent interest in Petropiar, which operates heavy oil production from Huyapari Field

relations.name: Petroindependencia
relations.quote: Chevron has a 35.8 percent interest in Petroindependencia, which includes the Carabobo 3 heavy oil project

relations.name: West African Gas Pipeline Company Limited
relations.quote: the company holds a 36.9 percent interest in the West African Gas Pipeline Company Limited affiliate, which supplies Nigerian natural gas to customers in Benin, Togo and Ghana.

relations.name: Singapore Refining Company
relations.quote: Singapore Refining Company (SRC), a 50 percent-owned joint venture, has a total capacity of 290,000 barrels of crude per day and manufactures a wide range of petroleum products.

relations.name: GS Caltex
relations.quote: The 50 percent-owned GS Caltex (GSC) Yeosu Refinery in South Korea remains one of the world's largest refineries with a total crude capacity of 800,000 barrels per day.

relations.name: Chevron Phillips Chemical Company LLC
relations.quote: CUSA also holds the company's investment in the Chevron Phillips Chemical Company LLC joint venture, which is accounted for using the equity method.
